parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$3k+3k+8k=1$, so $k=1/14$. B1. Table with outcomes $-2,2,3$ and at least one correct linked probability, FT their $k$. B1 FT. Two further correct probabilities; or three correct linked probabilities; or three correct FT probabilities using their $k$; or three incorrect probabilities summing to 1 if $k$ not stated. B1 FT. Condone additional $X$ values stated with probability 0. SC: if $k$ not calculated, B1 for table probabilities $3k,3k,8k$. Total 3.
Total [3]

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$E(X)=(-2)(3/14)+2(3/14)+3(8/14)=12/7$. M1; accept an unsimplified expression and it may be calculated in the variance. FT their table with 3 probabilities summing to $0.999\leq$ total $\leq1$, with $0<p<1$, or in terms of $k$.
$\operatorname{Var}(X)=(-2)^2(3/14)+2^2(3/14)+3^2(8/14)-[\text{their }E(X)]^2$. M1 appropriate variance formula using their $E(X)^2$. FT their table with 3 or more probabilities, $0<p<1$, which need not sum to 1, or in terms of $k$ with an expression no more evaluated than shown.
$E(X)=12/7=1.71=1\frac57$ and $\operatorname{Var}(X)=192/49=3.92=3\frac{45}{49}$. A1; answers must be identified. $E(X)$ may be identified by correct use in variance; condone $E,V,\mu,\sigma^2$, etc. If A0, SC B1 for identified correct final answers. Total [3].
